lines: Let a quantum system run for a random time. Then forget exactly when you stopped. What is left?
让一个量子系统运行一段随机的时间，然后忘掉你到底何时停下。还剩下什么？
This volume treats a clock not as a number line, but as a record the observer keeps: shared or independent, forgotten or retained. Each choice changes what can be known.
这卷理论不把时钟当成一条数轴，而是当成观察者保留的一份记录：共享的或独立的，忘记的或保留的。每一种选择，都会改变能够知道的东西。
Joint sources, quantum relations, and finite clocks.
联合来源、量子关系与有限时钟。
A shared phase copy is not an independent source. Forgetting a time is not obtaining it. A formal inverse is not a permitted reversal.
共享的相位副本不是独立来源。忘记时刻不是取得时刻。形式上的逆，不是被允许的反转。
Two Bell states, phi plus and phi minus. Each side, looked at alone, sees exactly the same maximally mixed state.
两个 Bell 态，phi 正与 phi 负。单独看每一侧，看到的都是完全相同的最大混合态。
Yet measure X on both sides and multiply: plus one for one state, minus one for the other. The difference lives only in the relation.
可是在两侧都测 X 再相乘：一个态给出正一，另一个给出负一。区别只存在于关系之中。
Now a family of two-qubit states with the same energy, the same one-sided states, and the same basis statistics: zero, one half, one half, zero. They differ only in a hidden coherence c.
现在看一族两比特态：能量相同，单侧态相同，基底统计也相同——零、二分之一、二分之一、零。它们只在一个隐藏的相干 c 上不同。
The state is entangled exactly when c is not zero. An energy-conserving gate turns c into a later local reading: two times the real part of c. No update rule on the summary can predict that.
当且仅当 c 不为零，这个态是纠缠的。一个守能的门会把 c 变成之后的局部读数：c 的实部的两倍。任何只作用于摘要的更新规则，都预测不了它。
How far is a qubit from the nearest state with a prescribed occupation? For interior targets the answer is linear in the mismatch, with sharp constant one over two root p times one minus p.
一个量子比特离指定占据数的最近态有多远？对内部目标，答案与偏差成线性，精确常数是二倍根号 p 乘一减 p 分之一。

At the poles it becomes a square root: a mismatch of one ten-thousandth needs a move of one hundredth. And the nearest-point map is not even a legal quantum channel: its Choi matrix has eigenvalue minus one half.
到了两极，它变成平方根：万分之一的偏差，需要百分之一的移动。而且最近点映射甚至不是合法的量子通道：它的 Choi 矩阵有一个负二分之一的本征值。
With one unknown phase, the plus state and the maximally mixed state look alike. Take two copies sharing that phase, and a joint test gives one half versus one quarter.
在一个未知相位下，正态和最大混合态看起来一样。取共享这个相位的两份副本，一个联合检验就给出二分之一对四分之一。
With energies zero, one and m, two states agree on every relation below m copies. For the hardest pairs, exactly two m minus one copies are needed, and never fewer.
当能量是零、一和 m 时，两个态在少于 m 份副本的所有关系上都一致。最难的一对，恰好需要二 m 减一份副本，一份都不能少。
Averaging over a random time multiplies each energy-gap coherence by the clock's resonance kernel. Equal energies survive. Different energies fade.
对随机时间取平均，会把每一个能隙相干乘上时钟的共振核。能量相同的保留下来，能量不同的逐渐消退。
With a uniform window of length T, the error is half the sinc of g T over two. It vanishes exactly at g T equal to two pi, then comes back. Waiting longer is not always better.
用长度为 T 的均匀窗口，误差是 g T 除以二的 sinc 的一半。它恰好在 g T 等于二 pi 时归零，然后又回来。等得更久，并不总是更好。
Now a clock that fires at times zero, two tau and three tau. A gap of two pi over tau fits every one of them exactly.
现在换一个时钟，它只在零、二 tau、三 tau 时刻触发。二 pi 除以 tau 的能隙，恰好契合每一个时刻。
That coherence is never erased, no matter how many times the clock is used. The kernel stays exactly one. Integer times alias; some gaps are simply invisible.
无论这个时钟用多少次，那个相干都不会被抹去，共振核始终精确等于一。整数时刻会产生别名；有些能隙就是看不见的。

Use the golden ratio instead: times zero, tau and phi tau. Irrational, so every gap is eventually erased. But choose gaps at Fibonacci multiples, and phi tau misses a full turn by only phi to the minus N.
改用黄金比：零、tau 和 phi tau 三个时刻。无理数，所以每个能隙最终都会被抹去。但若把能隙取在斐波那契倍数上，phi tau 离整圈只差 phi 的负 N 次方。

At Fibonacci two hundred thirty-three, after a hundred uses, the error is still zero point four nine nine. An exponential clock with the same mean wait drives it down fast. Same mean wait, completely different resolution.
在斐波那契数二百三十三处，用一百次之后，误差仍是零点四九九。平均等待相同的指数时钟，却能很快把它压下去。平均等待相同，分辨率截然不同。

Two clocks can have identical marginals, heads or tails half the time each, and still differ jointly. Ask whether the two clocks agree: a shared source says always, independent coins say half the time.
两个时钟的边缘分布可以完全相同——正反各半——联合起来却不同。问一句两个时钟是否一致：共享来源说总是一致，独立硬币说一半时候一致。
In quantum form, two atoms under one shared clock keep their exchange coherence forever. Under independent clocks it decays with every step.
换成量子形式：同一个共享时钟下的两个原子，永远保持它们的交换相干；在各自独立的时钟下，它每一步都在衰减。
Can a record recover the time a path has taken? Pair every two runs that leave the same visible record. The clock is readable exactly when every reachable pair costs the same.
一份记录能否恢复一条路径所用的时间？把每两个留下相同可见记录的运行配成一对。当且仅当每一个可达的配对代价都相同，时钟才可读。
If it fails, a witness appears within n squared steps, for n states. And a loop that returns to the same state cannot be timed by the state alone: you must remember the laps.
如果不可读，在 n 个状态下，n 的平方步之内必然出现证人。而一个回到同一状态的环，不能只靠状态来计时：你必须记住圈数。
One real source with a mod four clock has eight states. Cut it into two parties by parity, and gluing local views that match gives sixteen: eight are ghosts that never happen.
一个带模四时钟的真实来源有八个状态。按奇偶把它切给两方，把相互吻合的局部视图粘起来，会得到十六个：其中八个是从不发生的幽灵。
Cut along the sum instead, and the glue returns exactly the eight real states, using five bits instead of six. Where you cut space decides how much memory truth costs.
改沿和来切，粘合得到的就恰好是八个真实状态，只用五个比特而不是六个。在哪里切开空间，决定了真值要付多少记忆。

With three parties, every pairwise check can pass while the full triple is impossible: two hundred fifty-six tuples look consistent, only one hundred twenty-eight are real. The obstruction is a parity spread over all three.
三方的时候，每一对的检验都能通过，整个三元组却不可能：看起来相容的有二百五十六组，真实的只有一百二十八组。障碍是一个遍布三方的奇偶。
Changing the task afterwards costs exactly two r minus three bits of messages among r parties. A central helper with full access would need only one.
事后改变任务，在 r 方之间恰好要花二 r 减三个比特的消息。一个拥有全部访问权的中心助手，只需要一个。
Finally, how many states does it take to reproduce every output window? Two loops, printing zero zero zero one and zero zero one one, with windows of length three.
最后：重现每一个输出窗口需要多少状态？两个环，分别打印零零零一和零零一一，窗口长度为三。
Free machines need six. Reversible machines need seven. Commuting ones need eight. The same windows, three different prices, set by what the machine is allowed to do.
自由的机器需要六个。可逆的机器需要七个。交换的机器需要八个。同样的窗口，三种不同的价格，由机器被允许做什么来决定。
Relations hide what sides cannot see. Shared clocks keep what independent clocks erase. Cuts, records and contracts set the price of every answer.
关系藏着各侧看不见的东西。共享的时钟保住独立时钟抹去的东西。切法、记录与合同，决定每一个答案的价格。
A clock is not the time. It is the record you are still allowed to use.
时钟不是时间本身，而是你仍被允许使用的那份记录。
